summary: TMTG filed an 8-K disclosing an Amended and Restated Unsecured Convertible Promissory Note with TAE Technologies, consolidating the December 18, 2025 Original Note tied to their Merger Agreement where TMTG's subsidiary T Media Sub will acquire TAE. The Amended Note carries a $200M first tranche, with up to $100M more available during the Second Tranche Draw Period, which opened upon TMTG's same-day S-4 filing and ends November 29, 2026. Drawdowns must be at least $50M. Watch the regulatory clock and S-4 progress.
